facts.text: The resort spans 39 acres along Santa Maria Bay.
facts.excerpt: Spanning 39 acres along the gentle azure waters of Santa Maria Bay, Montage Los Cabos resort

facts.text: The hotel is set on the Golden Corridor, an undeveloped stretch between the hotel zones of Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is set on the Golden Corridor, an undeveloped stretch between the hotel zones of Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.

facts.text: The city centers of both Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo are each about a 20-minute taxi ride away.
facts.excerpt: the city centers of both Cabos are each a 20-minute taxi ride away

facts.text: The hotel faces the calm Santa Maria Bay, one of the rare beaches in Cabo without breaking waves where you can wade in and swim.
facts.excerpt: Cabo where there aren't crazy breaking waves and wily currents, where you can just wade right in and go for a swim

facts.text: The landscaping uses native and drought-tolerant plants such as rock figs, agave and saguaro instead of green lawns.
facts.excerpt: using native and drought-tolerant plants such as beautiful rock figs, all sorts of agave, and tall saguaro, instead of the area

facts.text: Montage Los Cabos is the first international hotel from the American-based Montage group.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is the first international hotel from the American-based Montage group

facts.text: Interiors use creamy sandstone, indigenous hardwood, updated equipale chairs and woven throws and wall hangings.
facts.excerpt: lots of creamy sandstone and indigenous hardwood, updated equipale chairs, and woven throws and wall hangings

facts.text: Buildings are low-slung and low-density.
facts.excerpt: Buildings are low-slung and low-density

facts.text: Many rooms have floor-to-ceiling glass doors leading to large terraces with daybeds, dining areas and outdoor showers.
facts.excerpt: huge floor-to-ceiling glass doors that lead to large terraces with daybeds and dining areas, and outdoor showers

facts.text: Guests wanting sea breezes and whale-spotting from the terrace can request a room close to the water.
facts.excerpt: For sea breezes and optimal whale-spotting from your terrace, request a room close to the water.

facts.text: Mezcal serves modern Mexican cuisine.
facts.excerpt: including modern Mexican cuisine at Mezcal

facts.text: Talay serves Thai-inspired street-food dishes from a food truck setup.

facts.text: Marea, the more casual restaurant, has a separate vegan menu.
facts.excerpt: Marea, the more casual restaurant, has a separate vegan menu

facts.text: The spa offers guided journeys with the hotel's resident shaman.
